epic.title: Character Builder: implementation roadmap and architecture-proof milestone
epic.body:
## Ability and skill baseline

Implement **only Modern 4e abilities and skills** for now. No vanilla ability-score allocation/modifier conversion, vanilla skill calculations, dual rules profiles, or automatic conversion between these models. All package configurations use this baseline; standard compendium content is source material requiring adaptation, not an alternate rules mode. Keep the one-class proof and small override; the proof class must use Modern 4e abilities and proficiencies.

Read `.agents/skills/modern4e/SKILL.md`, then the active `src/modern4e/helpers/class_reference.typ` (imported by `helpers/classes.typ`), `glossary/creation_&_advancement.typ`, `glossary/background.typ`, `glossary/skill_checks.typ`, and `glossary/balance_changes.typ`. Active rulebook sources take precedence over stale numeric summaries. Preserve incomplete-automation diagnostics for unadapted prerequisites; never silently apply vanilla math.

## Goal

Implement the [agreed architecture](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/blob/master/docs/character-builder-architecture.md) as bounded agent-ready tasks. User confirmed: one class using Modern 4e abilities and skills plus one small override first; decide broader playable coverage after proving the architecture. Fighter at levels 1–2 is a provisional engineering fixture. The demo override is not an approved Modern 4e rule.

## Execution

Start with foundation, then contract. Follow each ticket's prerequisites; independent ready tickets may be assigned separately. Establish public contracts before parallel implementation. Complete the end-to-end proof before expanding progression/content coverage. Do not execute the whole roadmap in a single agent task. All implementation tickets include their own tests; the proof ticket integrates them rather than deferring testing until the end.

## Tickets

- [ ] [Character Builder: Bootstrap Kotlin Multiplatform core and both application shells](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/4)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Define versioned character documents and content package contracts](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/5)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Implement portable character JSON codec and compatibility checks](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/6)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Convert offline compendium into validated JSON content packages](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/7)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Implement catalog search, package ordering and provenance resolution](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/8)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Calculate grants, choices, prerequisites and typed modifiers](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/9)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Implement shared character edits and initial level progression](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/10)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Handle changed definitions, missing custom content and package-switch previews](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/11)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Implement shared import collision and recovery workflow](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/12)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Implement web IndexedDB storage, bundled content and file exchange](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/13)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Implement Android file storage, bundled content and file exchange](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/14)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Author one standard proof class and a small declarative override](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/15)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Build the desktop web proof character workflow](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/16)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Build the native Android proof character workflow](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/17)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Make the web build usable offline and package reproducible app artifacts](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/18)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Verify the end-to-end architecture proof across web and Android](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/19)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Extend shared progression through level 30, retraining and multiclass choices](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/20)
- [ ] [Character Builder: Decide the first broader playable content set after the architecture proof](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/21)

## Completion

The initial milestone ends when the proof ticket passes both actual app workflows, offline use and bidirectional exchange. General progression and the broader-content decision are subsequent work, not blockers for the proof.

## Deferred scope

Hybrids; combat/session tracking; backend, accounts and cloud synchronization; shareable links; user package import/editor; Foundry/PDF export; historical rules pinning and automated content migration.

## Starting work

Start with [Bootstrap Kotlin Multiplatform core and both application shells](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/4). Prerequisite links in each issue are blocking implementation dependencies: merge and verify those contracts before starting dependent work. These are body links, not native GitHub blocking relationships.

## Outcome and scope

Create the smallest buildable shared Kotlin core, React/TypeScript desktop web shell, and Kotlin/Compose Android shell. Suggested home: src/character-builder/; choose and document the exact physical layout here, then downstream tickets use it.

## Prerequisites

None. Ready to begin.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Pin compatible toolchains and provide reproducible commands for shared JVM/JS tests, web development/build, and Android build/tests.
- [ ] Expose a tiny plain-data Kotlin/JS boundary consumed by TypeScript; Android calls the same Kotlin implementation directly.
- [ ] Run a common smoke fixture on JVM and JS and display its result in both shells.
- [ ] Keep this standalone project out of Foundry copying: no module.json; do not alter or deploy modern4e. Add CI for the buildable targets, documenting Android emulator requirements.

## Validation and boundaries

Build from a clean checkout; prove JS consumption and Android compilation. No character rules, full UI, content conversion, or hosting deployment in this ticket.

Read root AGENTS.md and the [agreed architecture](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/blob/master/docs/character-builder-architecture.md) before implementation. Inspect the merged prerequisite work for actual paths and public APIs; physical layout and signatures are established by the foundation/contract tickets, not assumed here. Keep UI presentation separate from shared rules, and rules separate from IO. Add automated behavior/edge-case tests in this ticket, run the affected suites, update FEATURES.md when behavior changes and tests/README.md when commands change. Include exact commands/results and remaining limitations in the PR. Do not claim unsupported automation is implemented. This standalone builder is not a Foundry module and must not be copied to Foundry. No hybrids, session state, backend/cloud sync, user package import/editor, Foundry/PDF export, historical rules pinning or automated content migration.

- [ ] Packages include stable ID, revision, dependencies, metadata/indexes and entry chunks. Entries separate identity, presentation/references, mechanics and supported/partial/unimplemented coverage.
- [ ] Define an initial fixed mechanical vocabulary for grants, choices, prerequisites, typed modifiers and class progression; no executable package extensions. Define deterministic fingerprints and shared structured diagnostics/results, including unavailable values.
- [ ] Define ContentSource, CharacterStore and file exchange boundaries. Calculated totals are derived, and portable characters contain no compendium descriptions or executable code.

## Outcome and scope

Implement shared catalog behavior above ContentSource so platform adapters only supply package data.

## Prerequisites

- [Character Builder: Define versioned character documents and content package contracts](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/5)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Start with standard content; apply a character's enabled packages in order, last definition by entry ID wins, replacing the entire entry rather than merging fields.
- [ ] Expose supplying package and fingerprint on resolved entries. Validate missing dependencies and unusable package configurations explicitly.
- [ ] Search metadata without eagerly loading descriptions; load details on demand and resolve internal references through the catalog.
- [ ] Distinguish absent expected suppliers/entries from ordinary lookup misses; never silently fall back to standard content for a saved custom selection.
- [ ] Ensure package order is per character, so characters with different content packages coexist under Modern 4e abilities and skills.

## Validation and boundaries

Fixtures cover reordered overrides, whole-entry replacement, duplicate IDs across packages, missing dependencies/entries, lazy loading and two characters with different package configurations. Content updates and deliberate switches are handled separately.

Roadmap: [Character Builder: implementation roadmap and architecture-proof milestone](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/3)

## Outcome and scope

Implement a pure shared engine taking character decisions plus resolved content and returning explained derived results. Scope mechanics to the initial proof vocabulary.

## Prerequisites

- [Character Builder: Define versioned character documents and content package contracts](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/5)
- [Character Builder: Implement catalog search, package ordering and provenance resolution](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/8)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Resolve grants and stable choice slots; report available choices and eligibility using supported prerequisites.
- [ ] Calculate the initial supported ability/statistic and typed-modifier operations with traceable contributors and documented published-rule stacking behavior.
- [ ] Represent unsupported prerequisites/mechanics as incomplete automation, missing definitions as unresolved, and provably illegal choices as invalid; distinguish unavailable calculations from numeric zero.
- [ ] Return selection-specific diagnostics, missing selections/dependencies, granted powers/features and automation coverage; avoid recursive grant crashes with explicit diagnostics.
- [ ] Manual adjustments use supported operations/stacking and the exact explanation label 'Manual Adjustment'; no required reason; adjustments do not erase incomplete-automation diagnostics.

## Validation and boundaries

JVM/JS tests cover same-type versus different-type stacking, untyped contributions as supported by sourced rules, manual adjustments, grant/choice resolution, unsupported prerequisites, invalid choices and propagation of missing dependencies. Read 4e-compendium skill for published rules; never put storage/network calls in the engine.

## Agent handoff

Read root AGENTS.md and the [agreed architecture](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/blob/master/docs/character-builder-architecture.md) before implementation. Inspect the merged prerequisite work for actual paths and public APIs; physical layout and signatures are established by the foundation/contract tickets, not assumed here. Include exact commands/results and remaining limitations in the PR. Do not claim unsupported automation is implemented. This standalone builder is not a Foundry module and must not be copied to Foundry. No hybrids, session state, backend/cloud sync, user package import/editor, Foundry/PDF export, historical rules pinning or automated content migration.

## Required Modern 4e acceptance

- [ ] Implement and test Modern 4e allocation budgets/caps/optional tradeoff from the active helper; skill mappings, +5 proficiency and explained ability-point contributions. Cover invalid allocations, duplicate proficiency grants without double +5, changed main ability and unsupported imported prerequisites. Do not inject vanilla half-level or score-to-modifier formulas into skill math. Background and two free skill selections are separate stable choice slots; unspecified duplicate-choice replacement rules require clarification rather than invention.

Extend the proven model/operations with published progression behavior; this is engine capability work with focused fixtures, not full compendium automation.

## Prerequisites

- [Character Builder: Verify the end-to-end architecture proof across web and Android](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/19)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Support sequential advancement and direct higher-level creation across levels 1–30, including paragon path and epic destiny choice slots and prerequisites.
- [ ] Model replacements and retraining as preserved level history; retain original slot identity and distinguish multiple grants and same-entry selections.
- [ ] Support multiclass feats and power replacement interactions, plus themes/backgrounds/equipment choices through the common vocabulary; hybrids remain out of scope.
- [ ] Revalidate downstream choices when earlier choices change without silently removing them; unknown mechanics remain incomplete rather than valid.
- [ ] Expose operations/results through both existing bindings and adapt both UIs to the added choice categories without duplicating rules. If UI changes exceed a focused PR, create linked follow-up issues before claiming the feature complete.

## Validation and boundaries

Use sourced golden fixtures for levels 1/10/11/20/21/30, direct-vs-sequential equivalent choices, retraining/replacements, multiclass eligibility and invalidation. Every supported mechanic needs JVM/JS coverage and affected UI behavior tests.

## Agent handoff

Read root AGENTS.md and the [agreed architecture](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/blob/master/docs/character-builder-architecture.md) before implementation. Inspect the merged prerequisite work for actual paths and public APIs; physical layout and signatures are established by the foundation/contract tickets, not assumed here. Keep UI presentation separate from shared rules, and rules separate from IO. Add automated behavior/edge-case tests in this ticket, run the affected suites, update FEATURES.md when behavior changes and tests/README.md when commands change. Include exact commands/results and remaining limitations in the PR. Do not claim unsupported automation is implemented. This standalone builder is not a Foundry module and must not be copied to Foundry. No hybrids, session state, backend/cloud sync, user package import/editor, Foundry/PDF export, historical rules pinning or automated content migration.

## Required Modern 4e acceptance

- [ ] Ability advancement follows Modern 4e: test level-4 non-main and level-8 main increases and the active advancement table. Higher-level local rules are explicitly provisional: preserve that status and resolve ambiguities with the user rather than substituting vanilla progression.

tickets.title: Character Builder: Decide the first broader playable content set after the architecture proof
tickets.body:
## Ability and skill baseline

Implement **only Modern 4e abilities and skills** for now. No vanilla ability-score allocation/modifier conversion, vanilla skill calculations, dual rules profiles, or automatic conversion between these models. All package configurations use this baseline; standard compendium content is source material requiring adaptation, not an alternate rules mode. Keep the one-class proof and small override; the proof class must use Modern 4e abilities and proficiencies.

Read `.agents/skills/modern4e/SKILL.md`, then the active `src/modern4e/helpers/class_reference.typ` (imported by `helpers/classes.typ`), `glossary/creation_&_advancement.typ`, `glossary/background.typ`, `glossary/skill_checks.typ`, and `glossary/balance_changes.typ`. Active rulebook sources take precedence over stale numeric summaries. Preserve incomplete-automation diagnostics for unadapted prerequisites; never silently apply vanilla math.

Roadmap: [Character Builder: implementation roadmap and architecture-proof milestone](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/3)

## Outcome and scope

Human decision ticket: user explicitly deferred broader class and Modern 4e coverage until the one-class proof is complete.

## Prerequisites

- [Character Builder: Verify the end-to-end architecture proof across web and Android](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/issues/19)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Present proof results, supported mechanical vocabulary and known automation gaps; ask the user which classes, level range, races and supporting content should become playable next.
- [ ] Agree specific standard and actual Modern 4e packages/overrides and a measurable coverage definition; do not treat the demo override as a Modern 4e decision.
- [ ] Record confirmed entry IDs/sources and required engine extensions, including how partial automation is presented.
- [ ] Split the approved scope into bounded follow-up content/engine issues with dependencies, fixtures and acceptance criteria; link them from the parent backlog.

## Validation and boundaries

This ticket requires the user's decision and must not be autonomously closed based on guessed preferences. No requirement to decide it before the proof. Broader content is intentionally not invented here.

## Agent handoff

Read root AGENTS.md and the [agreed architecture](https://github.com/BanterTheGreat/Foundry-Mono-Repo-4e/blob/master/docs/character-builder-architecture.md) before implementation. Inspect the merged prerequisite work for actual paths and public APIs; physical layout and signatures are established by the foundation/contract tickets, not assumed here. Keep UI presentation separate from shared rules, and rules separate from IO. Add automated behavior/edge-case tests in this ticket, run the affected suites, update FEATURES.md when behavior changes and tests/README.md when commands change. Include exact commands/results and remaining limitations in the PR. Do not claim unsupported automation is implemented. This standalone builder is not a Foundry module and must not be copied to Foundry. No hybrids, session state, backend/cloud sync, user package import/editor, Foundry/PDF export, historical rules pinning or automated content migration.

## Required Modern 4e acceptance

- [ ] Broader content remains a later human decision. Modern 4e abilities and skills are already decided and must not be deferred or reopened by this ticket.
